title: Make useful supplies available
applies_when: A pending objective needs supplies present on the map.
approach: Inspect nearby relevant stacks and worker access. Allow only identified useful supplies consistent with route safety.
Allowed loose ground stacks can be sources; a stockpile is not a universal prerequisite.
Allowing, hauling and delivering are different outcomes. Verify the flag change without claiming construction received materials.
verify: Observed item IDs, forbidden state, quantity, location and native worker checks.
Remaining material requirements; do not allocate the same stock to multiple projects independently.
reconsider: Supplies are unreachable, reserved, insufficient or exposed to threats.
